description: A Roman villa on the grounds of Dewlish house, primarily excavated between 1969 and 1979 by Putnam. A building constructed in the fourth phase of the villa has been variously identified as 'shrine-like' or even explicitly as a 'temple' (building 5), an associated building (building 6) was described by Putnam as a 'priest's house'. The villa went through a phase of aggrandisement in the early 4th CE which ultimately lead to the construction of the shrine-like building, probably around the mid 4th CE. The villa seems to have been in some state of disrepair by the early 5th CE but was still in use.
